info.title: Scriptivox Transcription API
info.summary: Transcribe recorded audio and video into text with word-level timestamps and speaker labels.
info.description:
The Scriptivox API turns recorded audio and video into text. Submit a file by public URL (a file,
a Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive share link, or a TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X or Snapchat post) or by
presigned upload, poll for the result or receive a webhook, and read back a structured transcript
with per-utterance and per-word timestamps, optional speaker diarization, and SRT/WebVTT/plain-text
exports.

**When to use it.** Batch or on-demand transcription of *recorded* media: meeting and interview
recordings, podcasts, lecture capture, call archives, video libraries that need captions, and
pipelines that need word-level timestamps for clip search. 119 languages. It is not a live
streaming or real-time dictation API — every job takes a complete file.

**Shape of an integration.** `POST /v1/transcribe` returns immediately with `status: "created"`;
the file is downloaded and validated in the background, so input errors surface later on
`GET /v1/transcribe/{id}` with `status: "failed"`, not on the submit call. A correct client must
handle failures on the poll path. The one exception is a social post link: it is checked on the
submit call (a few seconds), and a post that cannot be transcribed is refused there with a 400.

**Limits.** 5 GB per file, 1 second to 10 hours of audio, 26 accepted file formats. Source
audio is deleted 24 hours after the job ends; transcripts stay retrievable.

**Billing.** $0.20 per hour of audio, pay as you go. Cost is reserved once the duration is known
(after download or validation), not at submit time. Failed and cancelled jobs are free — the
reservation is released.

**Errors.** Every error response is `{"error": {"code", "message"}}` with a machine-readable code.
See https://platform.scriptivox.com/docs/api-reference#error-codes.

**Support.** Email support@scriptivox.com with the account email, the job id, when it happened
(with time zone) and the exact error code and message; never an API key. Any feedback or issue
sent to support, by email or any other channel, is resolved within 24 hours. This is our founders'
personal guarantee.

post.description: Accepts a job and returns immediately with status "created". Supply exactly one of `url` (we download the file) or `upload_id` (from POST /v1/upload). Download and validation happen in the background, so input problems surface on GET /v1/transcribe/{id} with status "failed" — not here. Duration and cost are determined after download or validation. Requires a non-zero balance: returns 402 ZERO_BALANCE at $0.

400.description: Invalid body (INVALID_REQUEST), unsupported media (INVALID_MEDIA_FORMAT), or an upload that was never completed, already consumed, or expired (FILE_NOT_UPLOADED, UPLOAD_ALREADY_USED, UPLOAD_EXPIRED, FILE_TOO_LARGE). Unknown top-level fields are rejected rather than ignored. For a TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X or Snapchat post that can't be transcribed: URL_NOT_ACCESSIBLE with `error.reason` link_not_verifiable, link_not_found, link_unsupported or link_no_media and `error.platform`, or DURATION_TOO_LONG when its video is longer than 10 hours. A link to a site whose links cannot be transcribed right now: INVALID_REQUEST with `error.reason` platform_disabled. In each case nothing is created or charged, and the `message` says why in plain words.

get.description: Returns the status and, once complete, the transcript. Poll until status is "completed" or "failed", or configure a webhook instead. parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Output format. `json` (default) returns the full structured response and works at any status. `srt`, `vtt` and `text` return the transcript directly with the matching Content-Type and require status=completed; otherwise they return 400 INVALID_REQUEST.

parameters.name: max_words
parameters.description: Caption segmentation: maximum words per cue. Only applies to format=srt|vtt (format=text is built from whole utterances and ignores the segmentation options). Whichever of max_words, max_chars and max_duration is exceeded first ends the cue.

parameters.name: max_chars
parameters.description: Caption segmentation: maximum characters per cue. The subtitle convention is about 80 (roughly 37 characters across two lines).

parameters.name: max_duration
parameters.description: Caption segmentation: maximum seconds a single cue stays on screen.

parameters.name: sentence_aware
parameters.description: Caption segmentation: end a cue at sentence-ending punctuation (. ! ?). Produces more natural breaks at the cost of more variable cue lengths.

parameters.name: include_speakers
parameters.description: Whether cues are prefixed with the speaker label. `auto` includes labels only when the job has more than one distinct speaker. Only meaningful for jobs created with diarize: true.

parameters.name: strip_chars
parameters.description: Characters to remove from cue text before output, e.g. `strip_chars=,.` drops all commas and periods.

parameters.name: include_timestamps

ApiKeyAuth.name: Authorization
ApiKeyAuth.description: Your API key, e.g. `Authorization: sk_live_...`. A `Bearer ` prefix is accepted but not required. Header names are case-insensitive. Create keys at https://platform.scriptivox.com/keys — at most 5 active keys per account.

XApiKey.name: X-Api-Key
XApiKey.description: Alternative to the Authorization header: `X-Api-Key: sk_live_...`.

Error.title: Error
Error.description: Every failed request returns this shape. `code` is stable and machine-readable; `message` is a sanitized, customer-safe string and never a raw stack trace; `request_id` identifies the request for support.

error.description: The error envelope. Always present on a failed request.

x-enumDescriptions.INVALID_REQUEST: Malformed request body or missing required fields. Also returned at once for a link to a site whose links cannot be transcribed right now (`error.reason` `platform_disabled`, `error.platform` names the site); the `message` says what to send instead.
x-enumDescriptions.INVALID_FILENAME: Filename is missing, too long, contains invalid characters, or has no extension
x-enumDescriptions.INVALID_MEDIA_FORMAT: Unsupported file extension at upload time (e.g. `.txt`, `.pdf`). Also returned later if the contents turn out not to be readable audio or video.
x-enumDescriptions.FILE_NOT_UPLOADED: File not found at the upload URL
x-enumDescriptions.UPLOAD_ALREADY_USED: Upload already used for a transcription
x-enumDescriptions.URL_NOT_ACCESSIBLE: A TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X or Snapchat post that can't be transcribed, refused when you send it: nothing is created or charged. `error.reason` says why: `link_not_verifiable` (private, deleted or not available in the region), `link_not_found` (the video can't be opened), `link_unsupported` (a kind of link that is not a video, such as a Facebook Page or profile), `link_no_media` (no audio or video, such as a photo post); `error.platform` names the site. Sending the same link again gives the same answer. Other links that can't be downloaded fail later on `GET /v1/transcribe/{id}`.
x-enumDescriptions.DURATION_TOO_LONG: A social post whose video is longer than 10 hours, refused when you send it (`error.platform` names the site). Nothing is created or charged.
x-enumDescriptions.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: Not enough balance for this transcription
x-enumDescriptions.ZERO_BALANCE: Balance is $0 or below: deposit required
x-enumDescriptions.FORBIDDEN: Request rejected upstream (e.g. by the network layer) before it reached the API.
x-enumDescriptions.METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED: The path exists but only accepts a different HTTP method. The response includes an `Allow` header naming the accepted method (e.g. `Allow: GET` if you POST to `/v1/balance`).
x-enumDescriptions.CONFLICT: Action not allowed in the current state (e.g. delete on an in-flight job, cancel on a job that is already transcribing or completed)
x-enumDescriptions.PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE: Request **body** exceeds 100KB. This is the JSON body, not the media file. Large files go to the presigned upload URL, which has its own 5 GB limit.
x-enumDescriptions.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Request body sent without `Content-Type: application/json` on a POST/PUT/PATCH. The response includes an `Accept-Post: application/json` header. Parameters are allowed (`application/json; charset=utf-8` works).
x-enumDescriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_LOCKED: Another request with the same `Idempotency-Key` is mid-flight. Retry after a few seconds (`Retry-After` header sent).
x-enumDescriptions.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT: `Idempotency-Key` reused with a different request body. Use a fresh key for a different operation.
x-enumDescriptions.RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Too many requests (see Rate Limits), or 25 jobs already in progress on POST /v1/transcribe. On POST /v1/transcribe with a social post link, also a limit on social links set on your account (`error.reason` `social_link_limit`, with `error.limit` and `error.window_seconds`; accounts have none unless Scriptivox sets one); uploads and other links are not affected. Wait the seconds in the `Retry-After` header.
x-enumDescriptions.LINK_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE: A social post link could not be checked right now, so nothing was created or charged. `error.reason` `verify_rate_limited`: link checks are busy (`Retry-After: 600`); `link_check_failed`: the check did not answer (`Retry-After: 60`). Send the same request again after that many seconds. Links to files and to Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive are not checked and are not affected.
x-enumDescriptions.MAINTENANCE: The API is briefly paused for maintenance. Nothing was created or charged. Retry after the number of seconds in the `Retry-After` header.
x-enumDescriptions.ENDPOINT_REMOVED: This endpoint has been removed. The `message` says what to use instead (for `POST /v1/accounts`: create the account at https://www.scriptivox.com/signup).
x-enumDescriptions.ISSUER_UNCONFIGURED: OAuth sign-in is not configured on this deployment.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

request_id.description: The id of this request, the same value as the `X-Request-Id` response header. Include it when you contact support.

reason.description: Why a link was refused on POST /v1/transcribe, when the code alone does not say: link_not_verifiable, link_not_found, link_unsupported, link_no_media (URL_NOT_ACCESSIBLE), platform_disabled (INVALID_REQUEST), social_link_limit (RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED), verify_rate_limited or link_check_failed (LINK_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE). New values may be added.

platform.description: The site of a refused social post link, in lower case (e.g. "instagram", "tiktok", "facebook", "x").

limit.description: On a 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED from POST /v1/transcribe: with reason social_link_limit, how many social links the account may send in `window_seconds`; otherwise the most jobs the account may have in progress at once.

window_seconds.description: With reason social_link_limit: the window of that limit, in seconds (10 minutes or 24 hours).

in_flight.description: On a 429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED for jobs in progress: how many of your jobs are in progress now.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Present on the gateway's own 429 responses alongside the Retry-After header. Not on a 429 from POST /v1/transcribe for jobs in progress or a social-link limit, nor on a 503.

error.message: Missing API key. Provide via Authorization header or x-api-key header.

upload_id.description: Pass this to POST /v1/transcribe once the PUT succeeds.

upload_url.description: Presigned URL to PUT the file bytes to.

method.description: HTTP method to use against upload_url.

CreateTranscriptionFromUrl.title: CreateTranscriptionFromUrl
CreateTranscriptionFromUrl.description: Transcribe a file we download from a public URL.

url.description: Anonymously accessible http or https URL. An anonymous GET must return the raw file bytes, not an HTML preview, login form or password page. Direct and presigned URLs (S3, GCS, Azure SAS) always work. Share links work only when set to "anyone with the link can view": Google Drive, Dropbox files (not /scl/fo/ folder links), and OneDrive personal /redir or onedrive.live.com links. OneDrive 1drv.ms/v/c/ and /p/c/ photo shares cannot be used — Microsoft routes them through SharePoint Photos, which requires sign-in. A public post on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X and Snapchat also works: send the post's own link (a video or a reel). It is checked when you send it, and a post that is private, deleted or has no video is refused at once with 400 URL_NOT_ACCESSIBLE (see `error.reason`), with nothing created or charged.

language.description: ISO 639-1 language code (with BCP-47 fallbacks such as `yue` and `kea`), e.g. "en", "es", "fr". Omit or pass null for auto-detection. Passing the language explicitly is recommended: it is faster (the model skips its detection pass) and avoids known auto-detect failure modes on short clips, code-switched audio, and files that open with music. Forcing a language the audio is not in can produce a translation rather than a transcription. Invalid codes return 400 INVALID_REQUEST.

diarize.description: Identify who said what and attach a speaker label to every utterance. Implies align: true, because speaker assignment needs word-level alignment.

speaker_count.description: Expected number of speakers. Requires diarize: true; passing it without diarize returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST. This is a soft prior, not a hard ceiling — the result may contain slightly more or fewer labels. Strongly recommended whenever the count is known: it measurably reduces over- and under-segmentation.

align.description: Produce word-level start/end timestamps plus per-word confidence where the alignment model supports it. Confidence is language-dependent and may be null. Ignored (treated as true) when diarize is true.

webhook_url.description: URL to receive the job's webhooks (processing, then completed or failed). Must be https://. Signed with the key's webhook signing secret and retried with backoff until your server answers 2xx — see https://platform.scriptivox.com/docs/webhooks.

CreateTranscriptionFromUpload.description: Transcribe a file previously sent to a presigned upload URL.

CreateTranscriptionRequest.title: CreateTranscriptionRequest
CreateTranscriptionRequest.description: Supply exactly one of `url` (Scriptivox downloads the file) or `upload_id` (returned by POST /v1/upload). Every other property is optional and shared by both forms.

id.description: Transcription id. Pass it to GET /v1/transcribe/{id} to poll for the result.

status.description: Always "created" here. The file has been accepted but not yet downloaded or validated, so this is not a statement that the input is usable.

message.description: Human-readable confirmation. Not machine-readable; do not branch on it.

status.description: A cancelled job is reported as "failed" with error.code CANCELLED — there is no separate "cancelled" status.

released_cents.description: Kept for compatibility, always 0: nothing is reserved before transcription starts, and a job can only be cancelled before then.

TranscriptionStatus.title: TranscriptionStatus
TranscriptionStatus.description: created: accepted, about to download or validate. downloading: URL flow only. processing: being transcribed. completed: result is populated. failed: inspect error.code.

TranscriptionError.title: TranscriptionError
TranscriptionError.description: Present when status is "failed". These codes surface only on GET /v1/transcribe/{id}, never on the submit call. Failed jobs are free — the reservation is released.

code.description: Stable machine-readable reason the job failed. Branch on this, never on message.

x-enumDescriptions.URL_NOT_ACCESSIBLE: URL flow only. Covers several non-fetchable cases: the URL returned 4xx/5xx; DNS didn't resolve; the connection was refused; the response was an HTML page instead of media (login/preview/folder/expired-link, or a video site's page instead of its video); the share requires sign-in (e.g. OneDrive `1drv.ms/v/c/…` SharePoint Photos shares); or the server returned a 200 with an empty body. For a social post that passed the check: its video file could not be downloaded, or the download links the site gave expired before the download and checking the post again did not give working ones. The `message` field names the specific cause when detectable.
x-enumDescriptions.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: URL flow only: the download started but was interrupted.
x-enumDescriptions.INVALID_MEDIA_FORMAT: The file downloaded but could not be read: not actually audio/video, no audio track, or **shorter than the 1-second minimum** (message names the measured duration, e.g. `"Audio too short (0.10s). Minimum duration is 1 second."`).
x-enumDescriptions.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than 5 GB. For a URL this is only known once the download reaches the limit.
x-enumDescriptions.DURATION_TOO_LONG: Audio exceeds the 10-hour limit (only known after probing duration).
x-enumDescriptions.INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE: Once the length was measured, the job cost more than your available balance. Nothing was charged. The `message` names the amount needed; add funds and submit again.
x-enumDescriptions.CREATED_TIMEOUT: Job sat in `created` for more than 30 minutes: the validation step never started.
x-enumDescriptions.DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT: Job sat in `downloading` for more than 15 minutes: the file download stalled.
x-enumDescriptions.PROCESSING_TIMEOUT: Job sat in `processing` for more than 45 minutes without a result.
x-enumDescriptions.BILLING_ERROR: Internal accounting issue while finalizing the charge. Your balance was **not** debited and the transcript was not delivered. Safe to retry.
x-enumDescriptions.INTERNAL_ERROR: A server-side step (e.g. queueing the job to our processing layer) failed after we accepted the request. Safe to retry.
x-enumDescriptions.CANCELLED: The transcription was cancelled by the customer via `POST /v1/transcribe/{id}/cancel`. You are not charged.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Wording may change between releases.

Word.title: Word
Word.description: Present only when align is effectively true. Leading whitespace is stripped — reconstruct spacing from utterance.text if you need it exactly.

word.description: The token as transcribed, including any trailing punctuation.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the audio.

end.description: Seconds from the start of the audio.

confidence.description: Null for languages whose alignment model does not report confidence. Handle null defensively.

start.description: Seconds from the start of the audio to the first word.

end.description: Seconds from the start of the audio to the last word.

text.description: The utterance as a single string, with original spacing.

speaker.description: Labels are "SPEAKER 1", "SPEAKER 2", ... (space, 1-indexed). Null when diarize is false.

confidence.description: Mean word confidence for this utterance. Null for languages whose alignment model does not report it.

words.description: Empty array when align is false.

full_transcript.description: The whole transcript as one string, utterances joined in order.

language.description: The language actually used, detected or supplied.

duration_seconds.description: Length of the decoded audio in seconds.

utterances.description: Speech segments in chronological order. This is the structure to iterate; full_transcript is a convenience.

TranscriptionSummary.title: TranscriptionSummary
TranscriptionSummary.description: A transcription without its transcript. This is what GET /v1/transcriptions returns per item.

id.description: Transcription id, as returned by POST /v1/transcribe.

audio_duration_seconds.description: Rounded to the nearest whole second. Null until the file has been probed.

file_size_bytes.description: Size of the source file. Null until it has been downloaded.

language.description: ISO code of the language used. Null until detection has run.

diarize.description: Whether speaker diarization was requested for this job.

speaker_count.description: The speaker count supplied on the request, not a detected one. Null when it was not supplied.

align.description: The effective value. Always true when diarize is true, even if the request passed align: false.

cost_cents.description: Fractional and exact, e.g. 0.061111 for an 11-second clip at $0.20/hour. The balance is debited against this precise value, not a rounded one.

progress.description: Free-text stage label while processing, e.g. "downloading". For display only — the machine-readable state is status.

created_at.description: When the job was accepted. RFC 3339, UTC.

started_at.description: When transcription began. Null while the job is still queued.

completed_at.description: When the job reached a terminal state. Null until then.

Transcription.title: Transcription
Transcription.description: A transcription including its result once complete. Some result fields depend on the flags the job was created with: result.speakers and utterances[].speaker are null when diarize is false, and utterances[].words is empty when align is false.

items.description: This page of transcriptions, newest first unless order says otherwise. Each item omits the heavy result object.

next_cursor.description: Pass back as the cursor query parameter for the next page. Null on the last page.

version.description: The API version this host serves, matching the URL prefix.

description.description: One sentence on what the API does.

base_url.description: Prefix every path in `endpoints` with this.

llms_txt.description: What the service is for, and when not to use it.

mcp.description: Model Context Protocol manifest, for agents that call tools natively.

authentication.description: How to authenticate every other operation: the scheme, the accepted headers, the key format, and where a human gets one.

endpoints.description: One entry per operation, with method, path and a one-line summary.

rate_limits.description: Per-IP and per-key ceilings, the header names that carry them, and where they are documented.

versioning.description: Versioning scheme, current version, policy URL, and the headers a deprecation would arrive on.

errors.description: The error envelope, and where the code list lives.

rating.description: How good the transcript is, 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent). Completed jobs only.

comment.description: A short comment on the transcript.

their_words.description: Your end user's own words, unchanged, if you have them.

problem.description: true to report a problem with this job (failed, empty or wrong). Needs what_happened.

what_happened.description: What went wrong, for a problem report.

transcription_id.description: The job the feedback is about.

id.description: The report id (null if a parallel call opened it a moment earlier).

status.description: Open until the team resolves it (within 24 hours).

added_to_open_report.description: True when this was added to a report on the same job that is still open.

opened_by_rating.description: True when a rating of 1 or 2 with words opened it.

problem_report_error.description: Set when the rating was saved but the problem report was not (for example the daily limit).

url.description: Where to send the test event. https:// only. Without it, the account's default webhook URL is used.

WebhookSendResult.description: What happened to one try of a webhook made on request.

url.description: Where the test event went (test only).

delivery_id.description: The X-Scriptivox-Delivery id of this event.

attempt.description: The X-Scriptivox-Attempt value of this try.

delivered.description: True when your server answered with a 2xx status.

response_code.description: The HTTP status your server answered, or null when there was no answer.

error.description: Why it was not delivered, e.g. "HTTP 500" or "No answer within 10 s.".

status.description: The event after this try: pending (automatic retries continue), succeeded, failed (no tries left, or 410), superseded.

next_attempt_at.description: When the next automatic retry is due, if any.

transcription_id.description: The job this event is about.

status.description: The job status when the event was made.

cost_cents.description: Reserved for this job, in cents; charged when it completes.

status.description: The job status when the event was made.

cost_cents.description: Charged for this job, in cents.

result.description: The transcript, the same as GET /v1/transcribe/{id} returns.

transcription_id.description: The job this event is about.

status.description: The job status when the event was made.

error.description: Why the job failed. Branch on error.code.

status.description: The job status when the event was made.

test.description: Always true: this is not about a real job.

message.description: A fixed sentence saying this is a test.

balance_cents.description: Total balance, in cents. Can be below zero after a refunded deposit.

reserved_cents.description: Held against in-progress transcriptions, in cents.

available_cents.description: balance_cents minus reserved_cents. Must be above zero to start a job.

price_per_hour_cents.description: Current price per hour of audio, in cents.

deposit_url.description: Where a human can add funds. Send a user here on a 402.

updated_at.description: When the balance last changed. RFC 3339, UTC.

auto_topup.title: AutoTopup
auto_topup.description: Auto top-up, set on the Billing page of the API dashboard. When on and available_cents falls below threshold_cents, the saved card is charged amount_cents, up to the monthly limit set there. A top-up shows on a later call, not this one.

threshold_cents.description: Top up when available_cents falls below this, in cents.

amount_cents.description: How much each top-up adds, in cents.
